data.name: Example: unit listing migration
data.description: A worked example. A unit listing report (awards and transactions) from the source system becomes an award file and a transaction file for the target system. In the source system every grant is its own plan; in the target it is one plan with subsequent grants and vestings, which does not affect the mapping.

data.name: ADD_DAYS
data.description: Moves a date by a number of days.

data.name: ADD_MONTHS
data.description: Moves a date by a number of months, staying in range (31 Jan + 1 month = 28/29 Feb).

data.name: ADD_YEARS
data.description: Moves a date by a number of years.

data.name: DATE
data.description: Builds a date.

data.name: DATE_DIFF
data.description: Whole 'days', 'months' or 'years' from start to end (negative if end is earlier).

data.name: DAY
data.description: The day of the month.

data.name: EXCEL_DATE
data.description: Converts an Excel serial date number (e.g. 45123) to a date.

data.name: MONTH
data.description: The month number.

data.name: PARSE_DATE
data.description: Reads text as a date using a layout such as 'dd/MM/yyyy'. Separate alternatives with '|'.

data.name: TODAY
data.description: Today's date.

data.name: YEAR
data.description: The year.

data.name: GROUP_COUNT
data.description: How many rows in this row's group satisfy the condition. [Columns] in the condition refer to the row being examined.

data.name: GROUP_ITEM
data.description: The value from the nth (1-based) row of the group that satisfies the condition; blank if there is no such row.

data.name: GROUP_SUM
data.description: Adds the value over the rows in this row's group that satisfy the condition (blank counts as zero).

data.name: GROUP_SUM_TO
data.description: Adds the value over the first n rows of the group that satisfy the condition (a running total; 0 for n = 0).

data.name: AND
data.description: True when every argument is true.

data.name: COALESCE
data.description: Returns the first value that is not blank.

data.name: ERROR
data.description: Stops this row with your own message. Use it to flag data that should never occur.
data.example: IF(ISBLANK([Employee ID]), ERROR('Employee ID is missing'), [Employee ID])

data.name: IF
data.description: Returns 'then' when the condition is true, otherwise 'else' (blank if omitted).

data.name: ISBLANK
data.description: True when the value is empty or only spaces.

data.name: ISDATE
data.description: True when the value is a yyyy-mm-dd date.

data.name: ISNUMBER
data.description: True when the value can be read as a number.

data.name: NOT
data.description: Reverses true and false.

data.name: OR
data.description: True when any argument is true.

data.name: ROW_NUMBER
data.description: The 1-based position of the source row being transformed.

data.name: SWITCH
data.signature: SWITCH(value, match1, result1, match2, result2, ..., default)
data.description: Compares the value with each match in turn and returns the matching result. An odd final argument is the default; without one an unmatched value is an error.

data.name: LOOKUP
data.description: Translates a value using one of the project's value maps. Without a default, a missing key is an error.

data.name: ABS
data.description: Removes the sign.

data.name: CEILING
data.description: Rounds up to a whole number.

data.name: FLOOR
data.description: Rounds down to a whole number.

data.name: MAX
data.description: The largest value.

data.name: MIN
data.description: The smallest value.

data.name: NUMBER
data.description: Reads text such as '1,250.50' or '£12' as a number.

data.name: ROUND
data.description: Rounds half away from zero.

data.name: SUM
data.description: Adds values, treating blanks as zero.

data.name: TRUNC
data.description: Cuts off digits without rounding, e.g. whole shares only.

data.name: CONCAT
data.description: Joins values into one piece of text. The & operator does the same.

data.name: CONTAINS
data.description: True when the text contains 'part' (ignoring case).

data.name: ENDS_WITH
data.description: True when the text ends with 'suffix' (ignoring case).

data.name: LEFT
data.description: The first characters of the text.

data.name: LEN
data.description: Number of characters.

data.name: LOWER
data.description: Converts to lower case.

data.name: MID
data.description: Part of the text, starting at the 1-based position.

data.name: PAD_LEFT
data.description: Pads the start of the text up to a length (padding defaults to a space).

data.name: REPLACE
data.description: Replaces every occurrence of 'find'.

data.name: RIGHT
data.description: The last characters of the text.

data.name: SPLIT
data.description: The nth piece (1-based) of text split on a separator; blank if there is no such piece.

data.name: STARTS_WITH
data.description: True when the text begins with 'prefix' (ignoring case).

data.name: TEXT
data.description: Formats a number or date as text, e.g. '0.00', '#,##0' or 'dd MMM yyyy'.

data.name: TRIM
data.description: Removes leading and trailing spaces.

data.name: UPPER
data.description: Converts to capitals.

data.name: Transactions
data.description: Transaction file: every purchase becomes one transaction, and every off transaction (TVOUT, SWOUT, SWIN) becomes one transaction per award tranche.
data.reviewNotes: Mapping agreed with the project team.

variables.name: off
variables.description: TVOUT, SWOUT and SWIN are off transactions: the source holds one line for both awards

variables.name: tranches
variables.expression: IF($off, IF(GROUP_COUNT([Tx Type] == 'AWARD') == 0, ERROR('No award rows were found for this transaction, so it cannot be split'), GROUP_COUNT([Tx Type] == 'AWARD')), 1)
variables.description: The target cannot group them, so an off transaction becomes one transaction per award tranche

variables.name: awardUnits
variables.description: Units across all the award tranches, the base for splitting a partial transaction in proportion

outputs.name: Transaction file
outputs.description: Purchases: one row. Off transactions: one row for each award tranche, taking the same share of each award, never first-in-first-out.

fields.expression: TRIM([Number]) & '-' & TRIM([Cont Type]) & '-' & TEXT(IF($off, GROUP_ITEM($index, PARSE_DATE([Due], 'dd/MM/yyyy|yyyy-MM-dd'), [Tx Type] == 'AWARD'), PARSE_DATE([Due], 'dd/MM/yyyy|yyyy-MM-dd')), 'yyyyMMdd')
fields.description: The tranche's own award: the nth award row of the group for an off transaction
the report's 'Invested' becomes the target's Transaction date

fields.expression: IF($off, ROUND($units * GROUP_SUM_TO($index, NUMBER([Units]), [Tx Type] == 'AWARD') / $awardUnits, 3) - ROUND($units * GROUP_SUM_TO($index - 1, NUMBER([Units]), [Tx Type] == 'AWARD') / $awardUnits, 3), $units)
fields.description: Running totals make the pieces add up exactly to the source line

fields.expression: IF($off, ROUND($amount * GROUP_SUM_TO($index, NUMBER([Units]), [Tx Type] == 'AWARD') / $awardUnits, 2) - ROUND($amount * GROUP_SUM_TO($index - 1, NUMBER([Units]), [Tx Type] == 'AWARD') / $awardUnits, 2), $amount)

controls.name: Units: source total equals target total
Amount: source total equals target total
